requirement_text:
On navigating to Leave page, I'm getting error and on clicking the request leave, in the pop up dialog the employees dropdown is not displaying results.
This was the error i got in the console: jquery-3.6.0.min.js:2
 Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'style')

Find the root cause and fix it so the user can able to request leave without any error !

requirements.text: The application must not throw a TypeError related to reading properties of undefined when navigating to the Leave page.
The employees dropdown in the Request Leave pop-up dialog must display results correctly.
The user must be able to request a leave successfully without encountering errors.
